G01-A1.ALLOWED_INTERPRETATION: A non-directional description of participation or range in a calendar-defined window relative to a named ordinary-conditions comparator; the nuisance diagnostic decides whether it is more than the general volatility regime.
BLOCKING_ASSUMPTIONS: Inside a month the state and comparator days share the slow participation and volatility regime, so the within-month difference removes it.
Weekday composition is removed by standardizing per year and weekday class (label-blind).
The claim is descriptive; it does not identify which participants act.
G01-A1.COUNTERFACTUAL_CLASS: Sign-flip randomization of the per-month state-minus-comparator difference, 20000 draws, seed 20261010 plus the hypothesis index, two-sided p = (1 + count(|T_perm| >= |T_obs|)) / (1 + draws). Months are time-separated and each difference is formed inside its month; a moving-block SE is reported.
G01-A1.ERA_INVARIANCE_RATIONALE: Venue and participant structure changed between 2017-2019 and 2020-2024; the epoch gate is assessed, never assumed.

EXPECTED_EFFECT.RATIONALE: The beta briefing ranks activity and range against recent same-window baselines and flags the extremes. A calendar state that shifts the target distribution by half a comparator SD roughly doubles the flag rate; a smaller shift is not worth a baseline correction or a user-facing sentence. Same bar as OWNER_CARDS_R03, set before any count or outcome.

G01-A1.FALSIFIABLE_CLAIM: mean over month units of mean z(state) - mean z(comparator), with target LOG_TRADE_COUNT, has the expected sign (POSITIVE), magnitude at least 0.5 comparator-SD and a Holm-adjusted two-sided p at or below 0.05 within TF-G01-A-TURN-OF-MONTH.

G01-A1.MECHANISM: Recurring fiat-rail cash flows (salary-linked purchases, monthly DCA, fund subscriptions, month-end marks) concentrate at the turn of the month, so participation is higher on those days.

BLOCKING_ASSUMPTIONS: Hour-specific trends in the 15:00-16:00 New York hour that are unrelated to ETFs would be attributed to the ETF era; the DiD against adjacent hours removes only afternoon-wide changes.
The standardization scale (per year, common across the three hours) is label-blind.
The claim is descriptive; it does not identify which participants act.
G01-B1.COUNTERFACTUAL_CLASS: Block permutation of era labels over blocks of 4 consecutive ISO weeks, 20000 draws, seed 20261011, two-sided p = (1 + count(|T_perm| >= |T_obs|)) / (1 + draws). The within-day difference removes day-level volatility; the 4-week blocks keep short-range serial dependence.
G01-B1.ERA_INVARIANCE_RATIONALE: A single post-launch year; epochs are 2024 quarters and the gate is assessed, never assumed.
G01-B1.EVENT_OR_STATE_DEFINITION: post-launch NYSE full trading days (2024-01-15..2024-12-31): z(15:00-16:00 NY) minus the mean z of 13:00-14:00 and 14:00-15:00 NY
